content.title: Swagelok 401-1625 Manual Lever Ball Valve, NPT Threaded
content.short_description: Swagelok 401-1625 is a manual lever-actuated ball valve with NPT threaded connections for fluid handling applications.
content.long_description:
The Swagelok 401-1625 is a ball valve designed for on/off flow control in industrial fluid handling systems. It is actuated by a manual lever, allowing direct operator control of the flow path without requiring pneumatic or electric power sources.

Connections are NPT threaded, allowing installation into piping and tubing systems using standard threaded fittings compatible with this thread standard. As a ball valve, the 401-1625 uses a rotating ball with a bore to control flow, providing a straightforward quarter-turn open/close operation.

This valve is categorized under Industrial Components > Fluid Handling > Industrial Valves and is suited for applications where manual, localized valve operation is required.
